name: BACH_0171
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and 5/5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 93%, Benign 6%, InSitu 1% | Clear top class |
| Conformal set | Normal only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 36th percentile | Typical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Both Normal | Concurs |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest lower-invasive term; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical level; spot check 20/20 [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical level; spot check 18/20 [F4] · Validated
- **Nuclear size** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · Mean 47 µm²; 0th percentile of reference [F7] · Measured
- **Neoplastic nuclei density** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · 1,500/mm² (86th percentile); runs against the Normal call · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Dense neoplastic nuclei (86th percentile) reflect true atypia, not normal epithelium.
- A focal lesion is missed: region 11 has the highest per-region invasive probability (25%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11** — highest per-region invasive probability (25%); confirm no focal invasive tumor.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 6** — 51–80 nuclei labeled neoplastic each; check for true atypia.
3. **Regions 7, 8** — pleomorphism concept (18/20 spot check) peaks here; confirm nuclei look benign.
